competency.title: Teach continual backprop — simulated task
competency.outcome: Teach another learner to reason about continual backprop using a selective dormant-unit reset trial. Use a seeded simulation with an explicit environment version.
competency.practice_task: Produce a lesson, coached exercise and blind learner transfer test grounded in a selective dormant-unit reset trial.
competency.setting_constraint: Use a seeded simulation with an explicit environment version.
required_evidence: a lesson, coached exercise and blind learner transfer test
Include the simulator config, seed band and baseline run.
Report plasticity recovery and retained skills with uncertainty or an explicit deterministic check.
Construct a negative control for the failure mode: resetting useful weights without rollback.

assessment.scoring: Each criterion: 0 absent, 1 partial, 2 demonstrated; require 2 on all four.
assessment.threshold_policy: Register the metric threshold, baseline, task budget and evaluator before exposing new items.
criteria: Concept: correctly state the assumptions and limits of continual backprop.
Practice: the learner succeeds on a new case without the answer key.
Measurement: report plasticity recovery and retained skills against a matched baseline with reproducible inputs.
Critical check: test for resetting useful weights without rollback; detect it or rule it out with evidence.

competency.source_policy: Reviewer must add a verified primary source before lesson status; no source is fabricated here.
competency.contamination_policy: No private items, answers, seeds or reviewer-only prompts in this public specification.
